subject.title: Do people ask you to prove macos-automator-mcp is safe?

question: Should the project turn this demand-discovery question into a maintained security-assurance surface, such as a threat model or review checklist?
rationale: Only maintainers can supply the requested user and security-team experience and decide whether ongoing security-assurance documentation is a project commitment.

options.title: Answer and observe demand
options.body: Reply with the project’s current practice and retain the discussion as discovery until concrete user or security-team requirements emerge.

options.title: Create a scoped documentation follow-up
options.body: Open a separate, specific documentation task for a threat model or security-review checklist if maintainers already know that assurance requests are recurring.

options.title: Adopt external scanner integration
options.body: Treat a scanner integration as a separately sponsored product proposal with defined scope, maintenance ownership, and validation criteria.

recommendation.title: Answer and observe demand
recommendation.body: Reply with the project’s current practice and retain the discussion as discovery until concrete user or security-team requirements emerge.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is best placed to answer whether users or security teams have made these requests and whether the project should support an assurance workflow.
